scheme_name: Technical Education Scholarship Scheme For Degree Level
other_conditions: Must be a bonafide Himachali resident
Must be a ward of a Himachal Pradesh Government employee
Must be pursuing a PG/Degree course in Engineering/Technology (including Architecture) approved by AICTE
Parents' total annual income must not exceed ₹36,000 (exempt for SC/ST students)
Must have secured at least 60% marks in the qualifying examination (exempt for SC/ST students)
Scholarship awarded based on poverty‑cum‑brilliance or brilliance criteria
Requires a recommendation from the principal or an authorized institute officer for award/renewal
Must execute a bond to serve Himachal Pradesh for at least five years after completion if required by the state government
Scholarship may be discontinued on failure in examinations or lack of satisfactory progress
benefits_summary: General category students receive ₹300 per month, while SC/ST students receive ₹500 per month (full scholarship).
